title: Iran Ready to Escalate War, Trump at RNC Convention
description:
“Bloomberg: The China Show” is your definitive source for news and analysis on the world's second-biggest economy. From politics and policy to tech and trends, Yvonne Man and David Ingles give global investors unique insight, delivering in-depth discussions with the newsmakers who matter.

Chapters:
00:00:00 - Bloomberg: The Asia Trade begins
00:00:57 - Bessent's $6B buyback plan disappoints investors
00:06:46 - Trump in Texas for RNC convention
00:12:53 - K2 Asset Management's George Boubouras on global markets outlook
00:21:08 - Apple enters foldable phone market with iPhone Duo
00:25:58 - Iran said to be ready to escalate war
00:29:55 - US Energy Secretary Chris Wright on gas prices
00:34:30 - Stonepeak Chairman, CEO and Co-Founder Mike Dorrell on data center investment
00:43:39 - Australia property stocks face worst year since 2010
00:47:36 - Markets open in Japan, South Korea and Australia
00:50:08 - Bessent's yen remarks risk pushing BOJ bets too far
00:54:28 - Eastspring Investments' Christina Woon on markets strategy
01:02:23 - Iranian official: Tehran ready for more intense war
01:07:27 - EXCLUSIVE: Axis Bank CEO Amitabh Chaudhry on impact of AI on jobs
01:13:38 - China firms turn to stock sales to fund AI spend
01:23:02 - Shield AI Co-Founder and President Brandon Tseng on business outlook
01:32:45 - Apple debuts foldable Duo in biggest-ever iPhone revamp
